hypothesis: At a fixed base planner, isolate extra-call compute from auxiliary content; compare the full predicted compiler record with its type+params projection, and compare predicted vs gold using the identical core envelope.
cost_contract: Reuse and account the exact frozen first-stage calls. Report newly incurred GPU time separately from reconstructed pipeline cost. The discarded-PE control is a greedy reproducibility/budget sanity control, not an extra reasoning opportunity. Oracle has privileged labels and is diagnostic only.
selection: Same pre-existing 48 dev E/I/N groups as fixed-planner-v1; no selection by observed success. No heldout tuning. Incomplete E/I/N groups are excluded from paired estimates but all calls and failures remain reported.
decision: Parser value needs SFT vs direct AND generic decomposition, with N preservation and costs. Predicted-core vs full-record tests representation only. Oracle-core vs predicted-core diagnoses compiler error; oracle-core failure diagnoses planner/interface limits. No arm alone proves necessity or novelty.
